_help: Pitch Deck Builder: the steps of the form, one slide each. Every step has a title (shown small on the slide) and fields. headline: the big line on the slide. points: one bullet per line (up to 4 show). stats: big numbers, one per line as label: value (up to 3 show). The visual templates are in data/tools/deck_templates.json.
